original: yāni saukhyāni saṃskṛtāni devādīnām asaṃskṛtāni yāni saukhyāniśrāvakānāṃ(ṇāṃ) sarvāṇi tāni saukhyāni prasūtāni mātur itaḥ sakāśād veditavyāni ato māteyaṃ teṣām apy arthakārikety uktaṃ syāt // 6//

original: yasmāt te sarve prajñāpāramitā [a]ta eva kartṛkarmakriyānupalambhād aviparyāsā bhavanty asau sātaiva(?) pradhānaṃ kāraṇam ityarthaḥ // 7 //

analyzed: tad ādhipatya nirjāta tvāt tena eva sarva guṇāḥ maitrī ādayaḥ viparyāsa rūpa dhāraṇāt dharmāḥ samyak ābhimukhyena utpadyante viparīta jñāna pūrvaṅgama tvāt sarva dharma adhigamasya na mātā kasyacid anuyāyinī tvena utpadyate iti evam sarva prakāreṇa sva para artham icchatā adhimuktiḥ utpādanīyā mātari iti uktam syāt iti

original: ato 'nantaraṃ svātmīkṛtajagatsvabhāvatvena parārthādhimuktiṃ vaktum āha- śakra ityādi / anayor dvayor bhāgayoḥ sthāpitayoḥ katara(raṃ)tvaṃ kauśikka bhāgaṃ gṛhnīyā iti jinena paripṛṣṭaḥ praśnaṃ [43a] yadi jinadhātu sarve sarvair bhūbhāgavyāpanāt paripūrṇāni śikhāparyantakaraṇāc cūḍikā baddhāni gaṅgānadīvālukasamāni syur buddhakṣetrāṇyeko bhāgaḥ /
analyzed: atas nantaram svātmīkṛta jagat svabhāva tvena parārtha adhimuktim vaktum āha śakraḥ ityādi anayoḥ dvayoḥ bhāgayoḥ sthāpitayoḥ katararan tvam kauśikka bhāgam gṛhnīyāḥ iti jinena paripṛṣṭaḥ praśnam yadi jina dhātu sarve sarvaiḥ bhū bhāga vyāpanāt paripūrṇāni śikhā paryanta karaṇāt cūḍikāḥ baddhāni gaṅgā nadī vāluka samāni syuḥ buddhakṣetrāṇi ekaḥ bhāgaḥ

original: tadā imām eva prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāgam ahaṃ gṛhnīyām ity evam uktavān iti gāthārthaḥ //

original: tathāgatagrahaṇaṃ pratyagauravo ko hetur ity āha-kiṅkāraṇam iti / pariharann āha-netyādi / na me tathāgataśarīreṣvagauravam / api tu khalu punar yathā rājānaṃ niḥśrito naras tadanubhāvād eva labhate sarvatra tadvijine deśe pūjām /

original: tathā prajñāpāramitāṃ niḥśrito buddha evāryadharmāṇāṃ hetutvena dhātus tadadhipatyāl labhate sarvatra traidhātuke pūjām / yatas tasmāt prajñāpāramitāyāḥ paribhāvitatvān māhātmyayogena sarvathā parivāsitatvāt tāni śarīrāṇi prāṇabhṛtaḥ pūjanti / evam ahaṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ svīkuryām // 2 //
analyzed: tathā prajñāpāramitām niḥśritaḥ buddhaḥ eva ārya dharmāṇām hetu tvena dhātuḥ tad ādhipatyāt labhate sarvatra traidhātuke pūjām yatas tasmāt prajñāpāramitāyāḥ paribhāvita tvāt māhātmya yogena sarvathā parivāsita tvāt tāni śarīrāṇi prāṇabhṛtaḥ pūjanti evam aham prajñāpāramitām svīkuryām

original: ye cāpi tamin samaye 'nāgatajinajananīm imaṃ dharmaśreṣṭhaṃ śrotum abhilāṣayogāc chandikāḥ karmaphalābhisampratyayād utpādayiṣyanti śraddhāṃ te ca dharmabhāṇakam viditvā svābhiprāyād asatkāryam uktam / apaga[61b]taśraddhatvāt premāpanīta gamiṣyanty anyatra prārthitārthaprāptivirahāt sadharma sa(sadurmana) itīdam api mārakarma // 6-7 //

original: ye 'pi ca vartamānā daśasu dikṣu lokanāthā bhagavantaḥ prajñāpāramitā ato mātur itas te sarve yathākramaprayogā[63a]bhyāsena prasūtāḥ prasavanti prasaviṣyanti cānāgatās teṣāṃ ca buddhānāṃ yathābhūtatattvadarśanāl lokasya darśikā saṃvarddhanāj janayitrī samutpādanān mātā jagatāṃ ca cittacaritāvabodhanāt parasattvacittacaritānāṃ nirdarśikā ca /

original: yukto 'viparītamārgaprayogabalād atas tathāgatānām utpādo lokadarśanādikaṃ tv ānantyāt katham ity āha-lokasyetyadi / lokasya sattvadhātor yā māyopamatvāt tathatā yā ca tathatārhatāṃ pratyekabuddhānāṃ ca yā tathatā yāvitathatā tathāgatānām ekaikaśā padārthopādhibhedābhāvāt /
analyzed: yuktaḥ viparīta mārga prayoga balāt atas tathāgatānām utpādaḥ loka darśana ādikam tu ānantyāt katham iti āha lokasya ityadi lokasya sattva dhātoḥ yā māyā upama tvāt tathatā yā ca tathatā arhatām pratyekabuddhānām ca yā tathatā yā avitathatā tathāgatānām ekaikaśās padārtha upādhi bheda abhāvāt

original: bhāgabhaga[va]tā tathā svarūpabhedāpratipatter ananyā prajñāpāramitayā hetubhūtayā / nirvikalpajñāne bhāvagammad buddhāḥ / yasmāt tathāgatenāto dharmadhātuvinirmuktatvenānupapatter lokadarśanādikaṃ tu bhavaty evānyathā sarvajñatasya vyavasthāpayitum aśakyatvād iti bhāvaḥ // 3 //
analyzed: bhāga bhagavatā tathā svarūpa bheda apratipatteḥ ananyā prajñāpāramitayā hetu bhūtayā nirvikalpa jñāne buddhāḥ yasmāt tathāgatena atas dharmadhātu vinirmukta tvena anupapatteḥ loka darśana ādikam tu bhavati eva anyathā sarvajña tasya vyavasthāpayitum aśakya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadanantaraṃ mārgajñatādvā[63b]reṇa śūnyatādijñānalakṣaṇakathanārtham āha-tiṣṭhantetyādi / pratyutpannatvena tiṣṭhatāṃ anāgatatvena lokaviduṣām atītatvena parinirvṛtānāṃ bhagavatāṃ yasmāt sthitaivaiṣā dharmānāṃ dharmatā dharmaniyamarūpatānyathā pramāṇavyāhatatvena viparyāsarūpatvāt muktyanupapatte[ḥ] yad uta śūnyadharmas tatas tām
analyzed: tad anantaram mārga jña tā dvābreṇa śūnyatā ādi jñāna lakṣaṇa kathana artham āha tiṣṭhantā ityādi pratyutpanna tvena tiṣṭhatām anāgata tvena loka viduṣām atīta tvena parinirvṛtānām bhagavatām yasmāt sthitā eva eṣā dharmānām dharmatā dharma niyama rūpatā anyathā pramāṇa vyāhata tvena viparyāsa rūpatvāt mukti anupapatteḥ yat uta śūnya dharmaḥ tatas tām ārya anupapatteḥ yat uta śūnya dharmaḥ tatas tām ārya anupapatteḥ yat uta śūnya dha

original: anutiṣṭhitaprayogatvena śūnyatādijñānasvarūpāṃ bodhisattvās tathatām anyathārthena tattvam adhigacchati(nti) / tasmād eva ca tathatāvabodhena sarvadharmādhigamād buddhā iti kṛtaṃ nāma tathāgatair jinaputrāṇām // 4 //
analyzed: anutiṣṭhita prayoga tvena śūnyatā ādi jñāna sva rūpām bodhisattvāḥ tathatām anyathā arthena tattvam tasmāt eva ca tathatā avabodhena sarva dharma adhigamāt buddhāḥ iti kṛtam nāma tathāgataiḥ jinaputrāṇām

original: yady evaṃ teṣāṃ śūnyatādijñāne kathaṃ sattvārtha ityāha-ayu gocaro daśetyādi / ayam asādhāraṇadharmādhigamo viṣayabhāvāpannatvād gocaro bhaviṣyad buddhatvāj jinaputrāṇām eva daśabalānāṃ vināyakānāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ manonukūlatvād ramyām atyuccai[ḥ] sthānatvād girim āśritāṃ tāṃ veditavyau(vyam) /
analyzed: yadi evam teṣām śūnyatā ādi jñāne katham sattva arthaḥ iti āha gocaraḥ daśa ityādi ayam asādhāraṇa dharma adhigamaḥ viṣaya bhāva āpanna tvāt gocaraḥ bhaviṣyat buddha tvāt jinaputrāṇām eva daśabalānām vināyakānām prajñāpāramitām manaḥ nukūla tvāt ramyām atyuccais sthāna tvāt girim āśritām tām vedita vyauvyam

original: yad uta mahākaruṇāsaṃ[64a]mukhībhāvena jātyādiviparyāsaduḥkhitāṃś ca sattvāṃs tribhyo narakādyapayebhyaḥ śūnyatādidharmadeśanayā vinayanāt samuddharanti / na ca śūnyatādijñānasampattyā sattvasaṃjñāpi teṣāṃ kadācid bhavati // 5 //
analyzed: yat uta mahā karuṇā saṃ mukhībhāvena jāti ādi viparyāsa duḥkhitān ca sattvān tribhyaḥ naraka ādi apayebhyaḥ śūnyatā ādi dharma deśanayā vinayanāt samuddharanti na ca śūnyatā ādi jñāna sampattyā sattva saṃjñā api teṣām kadācid bhavati

original: nanūpalambhādhiniviṣṭāt kathaṃ śūnyatādidharmadeśanayā vinayatīty āha-siṃho yathaivety āha / tathā siṃho girigahvaraikadeśaṃ niśritya bhayotpādanaparaṃ nādaṃ muñcati /
analyzed: nanu upalambha adhiniviṣṭāt katham śūnyatā ādi dharma deśanayā vinayati iti āha siṃhaḥ yathā evā iti āha tathā siṃhaḥ giri gahvara eka deśam niśritya bhaya utpādana param nādam muñcati

original: svayaṃ sarvabhayavigamād acchambhī svasthāne mṛgakṣudrakāṃs trāsayan tathā prajñāpāramitām aupalambhikair alabdhagādhāniḥśritya narāṇāṃ siṃho bodhisattvo 'vyāhatapramāṇopetaśūnyatādidharmadeśanayā nādaṃ muñcaty upalambhayābhāvād acchambhī pṛthutīrthikānāmātmīyādyabhiniveśe mukter abhāvād trāsa[ya]nn ato vinayatīti bhāvaḥ // 6 //
analyzed: svayam sarva bhaya vigamāt a chambhī sva sthāne mṛga kṣudrakān trāsayan tathā prajñāpāramitām aupalambhikaiḥ alabdha gādhāḥ niḥśritya narāṇām siṃhaḥ bodhisattvaḥ vyāhata pramāṇa upeta śūnyatā ādi dharma deśanayā nādam muñcati upalambhayā abhāvāt a chambhī pṛthu tīrthikānām ātmīya ādi abhiniveśe mukteḥ abhāvāt trāsayan atas vinayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: tad anantaraṃ sarvākārajñatādvāreṇa svadharmopaniḥśrayavihārādijñānalakṣaṇakathanārtham āha - ākāśvityādi / akāśaṃ niśritya yathā sūryo raśmisaha[64b]srair udkātapādātāpayatīmāṃ dharaṇīm andhakāravigamena darśayati ca sarvavastūnāṃ svarūpaṃ tathābhyasataprayogatvena prajñāpāramitāṃ svadharmopaniśrayaṃ vihārādijñānena niśritya sanmārgeṇa
analyzed: tat anantaram sarva ākārajña tā dvāreṇa svadharma upaniḥśraya vihāra ādi jñāna lakṣaṇa kathana artham āha akāśam niśritya yathā sūryaḥ raśmi saha udkāta pāda ātāpayati imām dharaṇīm andhakāra vigamena darśayati ca sarva vastūnām sva rūpam tathā abhyasata prayoga tvena prajñāpāramitām svadharma upaniśrayam vihāra ādi jñānena niśritya sat mārgeṇa

original: pratiṣṭhāpanena niyamānād dharmarājo bhagavān jagato 'vagrahaśoṣaṇāntāpayati tṛṣṇānanadīṃ dharmāś ca niścitya pratipattyā darśayati // 7 //

original: kathaṃ dharmāṇāṃ darśanam ity āha-rūpetyādi / pañcaskandhaiḥ sarvadharmasaṃgrahād rūpasya darśanaṃ yatra māyopa[ma]tve nāsty evaṃ vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāś cetanāyā vijñānam eva kuśalādidharmavāsanābhiś cittatvāc cittam / tāsya cānudarśanaṃ yatra nāsty ekānekasvabhāvavirahād idam evādarśanaṃ prajñācakṣuṣā dharmāṇāṃ darśanaṃ nirdiṣṭa tathāgatena /
analyzed: katham dharmāṇām darśanam iti āha rūpa ityādi pañca skandhaiḥ sarva dharma saṃgrahāt rūpasya darśanam yatra māyā upama tve na asti evam vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ cetanāyāḥ vijñānam eva kuśala ādi dharma vāsanābhiḥ citta tvāt cittam tā asya ca anudarśanam yatra na asti eka aneka svabhāva virahāt idam eva adarśanam prajñā cakṣuṣā dharmāṇām darśanam nirdiṣṭa tathāgatena

original: ato viparyāsavinivṛttena tu nimīlitākṣajātyandhādīnām iva pratyayavaikalyād amanasikārato vādarśanam eva darśanam uktaṃ tato 'sa.jñisamāpattyādivyutthitasyaiva yoginā bhāvābhāvābhiniveśam[65a]lasya kleśajñeyāvaraṇasyotpattir i[ti] matiḥ // 8 //

original: kim ivādarśanaṃ dharmāṇāṃ darśanam ity āha / ākāśv ityādi / yathākāśaṃ sarvadravyābhāvamātratvenātikrāntapratyakṣānumānapramāṇaviṣayatvād adṛṣṭam iti sattvāḥ saṃvṛtyā vyavaharanti /

original: tattvataḥ punaḥ khasyāvidyamānatvān niścitaikāntarūpeṇa darśanam ukta[m a]to 'pi tu naiva tasmād yuktyā nirūpaṇāt vimr.śyatainam artham ākāśadarśanavyavahāram adarśanam eva darśanapāridaśaṣyāt(?) (°PAARIDAR"SA°?) pratipadyadhvam /
analyzed: tattvataḥ punar khasya avidyamāna tvāt niścita ekānta rūpeṇa darśanam uktam tu na eva tasmāt yuktyā nirūpaṇāt artham ākāśa darśana vyavahāram adarśanam eva darśana pāridaśaṣyāt

original: katham atra prajñāyā vyāpāra iti dṛṣṭāntapūrvakam anvayavyatirekamukhena pariharann āha-sāmudrītyādi / sāmudrikāyāṃ yathā nāvi pralugnāyāṃ mṛtakaṃ ma[66b]nuṣyaṃ tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā 'lambanaṃ kaścid agṛhṇan vināśaṃ prayāti jalamadhye aprāptatīraḥ / yas tu punarmrṭakādikaṃ gṛhṇāti sa sukhena vrajati pāramata eva sthalaṃ prayāti /

original: evam eva śraddhām upagatā ye prasādamātrāt prajñāpāramitāṃ mātaram anālambanād yadā vivarjayanti / rāgādiduḥkhaduravagrāhatvena saṃsārasāgare tadā sarvakālaṃ śraddhāmātreṇa viparyāsāprahāṇāt te saṃsaranti /

original: ye te punaḥ śraddhābalo bhavanti varaprajñaparigṛhītā viditamāyopamavastusvabhāvatvād bhāvakuśalāḥ /pratītyasamutpādadharmatābalena nirvāṇasyāpi darśanāt paramārthadarśinas te śraddhāprajñābalād yathākramaṃ puṇyajñānasaṃbhṛtaṃ paripūrṇaṃ...[67a] yānapātrapramuditādibhūmisvabhāvam eṣāṃ vidyata iti /

original: tathoktāḥ santaḥ śrāvakādyaviṣayatvena paramādbhutāṃ sugatānāṃ bodhiṃ tathaiva spṛśanti śīghraṃ / ato viśeṣalakṣaṇārthinā dvayaṃ nirantaram ālambanīyam ity uktaṃ bhavet / ālambanānālambanodāharaṇaṃ ca yathāyogaṃ sāntaranirantarakāriṇau vipakṣabhāvaparidīpanārtham // 2-4 //

original: etad eva dva[ya]m adhigamya viśiṣṭam ādhārabhūtam iti pūrvavat kathayann āha-ghaṭetyādi / ghaṭakenāparipakvena yathodakaṃ parivahati /
analyzed: etat eva dvayam adhigamya viśiṣṭam ādhāra bhūtam iti pūrvavat kathayan āha ghaṭa ityādi ghaṭakena aparipakvena yathā udakam parivahati

original: kasmiṃścit sati jñātavyaṃ kṣipram ayaṃ ghaṭe nāsty atyudakavahane 'kṣamatvena du[rba]latvāt paripakvena tu ghaṭenodakaṃ parivahan mārge na ca bhedanād bhayam upetyasyāpy uttareṇāmi(pi) sambandhād gacchati cāntaropadravāt svastinā gṛham /

original: tathā yady api śrāddhaḥ samparigṛhṇan dharmavicaya[67b]lakṣaṇaṃ prajñām atikramya śrāvakādibhūmidvayaṃ viśeṣamārgalābhāt prāpsyati agrabodhim // 5-6 //

original: paripakvām aghaṭau pratipatyapratipattidharmayor ādhārabhāvasandarśanārthau nanv anyeṣām apy ādhārabhāve katha[m a]nayor eveti prādhānyāt tathaiva pariha[ra]nn āha-nāvetyādi / naur yathā pūtikāṣṭhādi-apanayanād aparikarmmakṛtā mahāsamudrai(dre) vilayaṃ prayāti sadhanā saha vaṇigbhiḥ /
analyzed: paripakvām aghaṭau pratipati apratipatti dharmayoḥ ādhāra bhāva sandarśana arthau nanu anyeṣām api ādhāra bhāve katham anayoḥ eva iti prādhānyāt tathā eva pariharan āha nāvā ityādi nauḥ yathā pūti kāṣṭha ādi apanayanāt a parikarmma kṛtā mahā samudra aidre vilayam prayāti sa dhanā saha vaṇigbhiḥ

original: sā caiva nauḥ parikarmakṛtānukūlavātatvāt suyuktā na ca vi(bhi)dyate dhanasamaṃginī copaiti tīram / evam eva śraddhāparibhāvito bodhisattvaḥ prajñāvihīno laghv anuttarabodhitaḥ sakāśādaprāptapariṇyāma(?)m upaiti hāniṃ sa eva śraddhāparibhāvanto bodhisattvaḥ prajñāyāṃ varapāramitāyāṃ śobhanaṃ yuktaḥ sannakṣato anyatra pātābhāvāt /
analyzed: sā ca eva nauḥ parikarma kṛta anukūla vāta tvāt su yuktā na ca vibhidyate dhana samaṃginī ca upaiti tīram evam eva śraddhā paribhāvitaḥ bodhisattvaḥ prajñā vihīnaḥ laghu anuttara bodhitaḥ sakāśāt aprāpta pariṇyāmam upaiti hānim saḥ eva śraddhā paribhāvantaḥ bodhisattvaḥ prajñāyām vara pāramitāyām śobhanam yuktaḥ san akṣataḥ anyatra pāta abhāvāt

original: anupahataś ca svayāne samyakpravṛttatvāt spṛśati / tathaiva jinānāṃ bodhimato dvayam eva pratipatteḥ sākalyam iti jñāpitam / ākoṭitānāṃ [68a] koṭitānāṃ naugrahaṇaṃ pratipatyapratipattisākalyajñāpanārtham etad eva dvayaṃ samparigraha iti // 7-8 //

original: tathaivāha-puruṣo hītyādi / yathā kaścit puruṣo jarājarjaritagātratvāj jīrṇo bhojanādivaikalyena duḥkhitah śatādhikaviṃśativarṣo yady api kaścid āsanād uttiṣṭhati svayaṃ tathāpi krośam arddhakrośaṃ vā sahāyābhāvenāśaktatvād yo na prabhavati gantum / sa yadā vāmadakṣiṇabāhudvaye puruṣair gṛhītaḥ syāt tadā vā patanād bhayaṃ na bhavati /
analyzed: tathā eva āha puruṣaḥ hi ityādi yathā kaścid puruṣaḥ jarā jarjarita gātra tvāt jīrṇaḥ bhojana ādi vaikalyena duḥkhitaḥ śata adhika viṃśati varṣaḥ yadi api kaścid āsanāt uttiṣṭhati svayam tathā api krośam arddha krośam vā sahāya abhāvena aśakta tvāt yaḥ na prabhavati gantum sa yadā vāma dakṣiṇa bāhu dvaye puruṣaiḥ gṛhītaḥ syāt tadā vā patanāt bhayam na bhavati

original: yāvad gantavyañ ca sthānaṃ vrajati sukhena / evam eva prajñāyām anadhimokṣād iha yo durbalo bodhisattvo yady api śraddhāmātreṇa gantuṃ pratiṣṭhate / tathāpi dharmatattvasānāthyavirahāc chrāvakādibhūmau pātena bhagnatvād bhajyate 'ntarāle /
analyzed: yāvat gantavyam ca sthānam vrajati sukhena evam eva prajñāyām anadhimokṣāt iha yaḥ durbalaḥ bodhisattvaḥ yadi api śraddhā mātreṇa gantum pratiṣṭhate tathā api dharma tattva sānāthya virahāt śrāvaka ādi bhūmau pātena bhagna tvāt bhajyate ntarāle

original: sa eva yathopāyabhūtayā varaprajñayā parigṛhītas tadā na bhajyate spṛśati ca viśeṣalakṣaṇādhigamān nararṣabhāṇāṃ bhagavatāṃ bodhimato jīrṇapuru[68b]ṣasya parigrahāparigrahodāharaṇaṃ prajñāpāramitopāyakauśalyaparigrahāparigrahābhyāṃ yathā yogaṃ saṃsāranirvāṇaikāntapātāpātaparidīpanārthaṃ...bhaved iti // 9-10

original: yathoktena nyāyena viśeṣamārgaprāptāv āsvādanopalambhaḥ kalyāṇamitrabalān na kārya ity āha-ya ityādi / ye bodhisattvāḥ prathamaṃ viśeṣala[kṣa]ṇai[ḥ] pravṛttatvād ādikarmikabhūmau sthitāḥ kalyāṇakāśa(ma)tvād adhyāśayena varāyāṃ buddhabodhau prasthitās tair doṣāgrahaṇāt suśiṣyair bahumānatayārādhanād gurugaurāsaṃyuktaiḥ /
analyzed: yathā uktena nyāyena viśeṣa mārga prāptau āsvādana upalambhaḥ kalyāṇa mitra balāt na kāryaḥ iti āha ye ityādi ye bodhisattvāḥ prathamam viśeṣa lakṣaṇaiḥ pravṛtta tvāt ādikarmika bhūmau sthitāḥ kalyāṇa kāśa ma tvāt adhyāśayena varāyām buddha bodhau prasthitāḥ taiḥ doṣa agrahaṇāt su śiṣyaiḥ bahu māna tayā ārādhanāt guru gaurā saṃyuktaiḥ

original: kalyāṇamitrāṇi sarvakālam upasthānādinā sevitavyāni tacccitasaṃrakṣaṇād vijñaiḥ // 1 //
analyzed: kalyāṇa mitrāṇi sarvakālam upasthāna ādinā sevitavyāni tad cita saṃrakṣaṇāt vijñaiḥ

original: kalyāṇamitrasevāyāṃ ko heur ityāha-kiṃ kāraṇam iti / pariharann āha-tatvityādi / yasmāt tataḥ kalyāṇamitrebhyo viśeṣalakṣaṇaguṇā[69a]nāṃ prāpaṇād āgamo bhavati / tadavavādānuśāsanībhyām āsvādanopalambhābhāvāt paṇḍitānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ (tānāṃ) ca tāni kalyāṇamitrāṇi anuśāsayanti /
analyzed: kalyāṇa mitra sevāyām kaḥ heuḥ iti āha kim kāraṇam iti pariharan āha tatu ityādi yasmāt tatas kalyāṇa mitrebhyaḥ prāpaṇāt āgamaḥ bhavati tad avavāda anuśāsanībhyām āsvādana upalambha abhāvāt paṇḍitānām śiṣyāṇām prajñāpāramitām tānām ca tāni kalyāṇa mitrāṇi anuśāsayanti

original: tasmād evaṃ jino bhaṇitavān prahīṇasarvāvaraṇatvāt sarvaguṇāgradhārī kalyāṇamitrāṇy upaniśritā buddhadharmā viśeṣalakṣaṇasvabhāvā sati (ataḥ) tāni sevitavyānīti matiḥ // 2 //
analyzed: tasmāt evam jinaḥ bhaṇitavān prahīṇa sarva āvaraṇa tvāt sarva guṇa agra dhārī kalyāṇa mitrāṇi upaniśritāḥ buddha dharmāḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇa svabhāvā sati atas tāni sevitavyāni iti matiḥ

original: kīdṛśī teṣām avavādānuśāsanīty āha-dānaṃ cetyādi / dānādibhiḥ sarvadharmasaṃgrahād upalambharūpeṇa pravṛtāḥ ṣaṭ pāramitāḥ karmakartṛkriyānupalambhenānyathā rūpaparivartanād āsvādanopalambhaparihāṇaye pariṇāmayitavyā bodhau tannimittam /
analyzed: kīdṛśī teṣām avavāda anuśāsanī iti āha dānam ca ityādi dāna ādibhiḥ sarva dharma saṃgrahāt upalambha rūpeṇa pravṛtāḥ ṣaḍ pāramitāḥ karma kartṛ kriyā anupalambhena anyathā rūpa parivartanāt āsvādana upalambha parihāṇaye pariṇāmayitavyāḥ bodhau tad nimittam

original: na ca bodhiskandhā nānāsravaphalabhūtā śīlādiskandhān yuktyā ca sthāpanād vimṛśya paścāt tatparāmarṣapratyayenāsvādanopalambhā[t] yaḥ parāmṛṣed iti / deśanā ca ye prathamaṃ prayuktatvād adikarmikās teṣāṃ niśca[69b]yena yuktyā māyopamatāvabodhanād deśayitavyaiva anyathā 'nadhimokṣeṇottrāsād iti bhāvaḥ // 3 //
analyzed: na ca bodhi skandhā nānā āsrava phala bhūtā śīla ādi skandhān yuktyā ca sthāpanāt vimṛśya paścāt tad parāmarṣa pratyayena āsvādana upalambhāt yaḥ parāmṛṣet iti deśanā ca ye prathamam prayukta tvāt teṣām niścabyena yuktyā māyā upamatā avabodhanāt deśayitavyā eva anyathā n adhimokṣeṇa uttrāsāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: svārthasampatyā jñānaviśeṣalakṣaṇanirdeśānāntaraparārthasaṃpatyā prayogānāṃ hitādikāritralakṣaṇaṃ kathayann āha-evam ityādi / jñānaviśeṣalakṣaṇaparijñānād evaṃ prayogeṣu bhāvanābalād bodhisattvāś caranto dharmadeśanāyā 'nāgatasukhopasaṃhāreṇa duravagāhaguṇatvād guṇasāgarāḥ / pratyutpannasukhapratyarpaṇena santoṣaṇād vādicandrāḥ /
analyzed: svārtha sampatyā jñāna viśeṣa lakṣaṇa nirdeśa anāntara para artha saṃpatyā prayogānām hita ādi kāritra lakṣaṇam kathayan āha evam ityādi jñāna viśeṣa lakṣaṇa parijñānāt evam prayogeṣu bhāvanā balāt bodhisattvāḥ carantaḥ dharma deśanāyāḥ nāgata sukha upasaṃhāreṇa duravagāha guṇa tvāt guṇa sāgarāḥ pratyutpanna sukha pratyarpaṇena santoṣaṇāt vādi candrāḥ

original: tato vyutthāya mātaram imāṃ dharmaṃ yathāvat sattvān bhaṇedato viśiṣṭacittapūrvakaṃ dharmadānam ayaṃ puṇyam apekṣya nikṛṣṭabhāgānupapatteḥ kalāmātra. puṇyaṃ na bhavati / pūrvake dāne śīlaṃ saṃrakṣaṇe satyapi draṣṭavyaṃ tathā prakṛtatvāt // 4 //
analyzed: tatas vyutthāya mātaram imām dharmam yathāvat sattvān bhaṇet atas viśiṣṭa citta pūrvakam dharma dānam ayam puṇyam apekṣya nikṛṣṭa bhāga anupapatteḥ kalā mātra puṇyam na bhavati pūrvake dāne śīlam saṃrakṣaṇe sati api draṣṭavyam tathā prakṛta tvāt

original: madhyamārgārtham āha-yaityādi / yo bodhisattvo varāṃ prajñāṃ madhamārgasvabhāvāṃ vibhāvya tato vyutthitaḥ kathayed dharmam / sarvopalepābhāvān nirupalepam /
analyzed: madhya mārga artham yaḥ bodhisattvaḥ varām prajñām vibhāvya tatas vyutthitaḥ kathayet dharmam sarva upalepa abhāvāt nirupalepam

original: taṃ ca dīyamānam api(dhi)dharmam [78a] pariṇāmayej jagatām abhyudayanaiḥ śreyas āvāptilakṣaṇasyārthasya pradhānakāraṇatvena nidānabhūtāyāṃ bodhāv evaṃ dharmadānapariṇāmanāsamuttham yat puṇyaṃ tena saha yat sambhavet tac chubhaṃ trilokyāṃ na ba.vidyata iti yojyam // 5 //
analyzed: tam ca dīyamānam apidhi dharmam pariṇāmayet jagatām abhyudayanaiḥ śreyaḥ āvāpti lakṣaṇasya arthasya pradhāna kāraṇa tvena nidāna bhūtāyām bodhau evam dharma dāna pariṇāmanā samuttham yat puṇyam tena saha yat sambhavet tat śubham trilokyām na yojyam 5

original: adhimātramārgam āha-taś cai(ñ cāi)vetyādi / yathoktamārgabhāvanābalād yadā tat sarvapuṇyaṃ punaḥ pratibhāsate / kalpitarūpaviyogād uktam / evaṃ vikalpitadharmavihārāc chūnyakaṃ tathā dharmatāsvabhāvavaikalyāt tucchakam evam api satsaṃvṛtyā hetupratibaddhajanmatvād vaśikaṃ māyāmayatvād asārakaṃ ca pratibhāti /

original: tat kathaṃ jinaputrāṇāṃ tāvad iti ced āha-abhilāṣetyādi / prajñaptimātrasvabhāvatvād abhilāṣamātrān imān mṛdumadhyā[78b]dhimātraprakārān sarvadharmān svaparārthobhayasampattiṣv adhikṛtatvāt /

original: pratyakṣānumānāgamapramānaṇiścitatvāt vā bhavatā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ deśitān prayuktān prakāśitāṃś ca yo bodhisattvo bhāvanāmārgābhyāsāc chrutādijñānodayena jānāti kalpānāṃ koṭī niyutāni bahūni bhāṣyamānān sa tathaikarasattvāt dharmadhātur jinatayor vipakṣāpagamāvān naiva kṣīyate /
analyzed: pratyakṣa anumāna āgama pramāna niścita tvāt vā bhavatā yathāsaṃkhyam deśitān prayuktān prakāśitān ca yaḥ bodhisattvaḥ bhāvanā mārga abhyāsāt śruta ādi jñāna udayena jānāti kalpānām koṭī niyutāni bahūni bhāṣyamānān sa tathā ekara sattvāt dharmadhātuḥ jina tayoḥ vipakṣa apagama āvān na eva kṣīyate

original: tasya ca prathamacittasya bodhiṃ spṛśatā rūpeṇa sarvathā 'vidyamānatvād asatā na punaḥ śakyā dvitīyenaiva cittenādhigantuṃ bhavati viśiṣṭātiśayādhānābhāvāt na cittaṃ paścimam eva pūrvavat sarvopadravaśamanāc chivāṃ bodhim anu[80a]prāpnoti / tasya dvitīyacittasya bodhiṃ prāpnuvatā rūpeṇa sarvathāvidyamānatvāt /

original: asatā na punaḥ prathamenaiva cittena prāptuṃ śakyā bhavati viśiṣṭātiśayādhānābhāvāt / ato vartidāhavat pūrvāparacittakṣaṇābhyāṃ bodhiḥ prāpyata ity uktaṃ bhavet // 2 //

original: pūrvāparacittakṣaṇayor bodhau sāmānyena kāraṇatvān nirdiśyedānīṃ prathamacittakṣaṇasyopādānakāraṇatvā(tva)m anvayavyatirekamukhena dṛṣṭāntapūrvakaṃ spaṣṭayann āha-bījetyādi / nityasya kramayaugapadyābhyām arthakriyāvirodhena kṣaṇitkato 'śvatthādibījādeḥ cottarottarakṣaṇapariṇāmena tanukārīṇi viṭapādīni samyagātmabhāvalābhāt samāgacchanti /
analyzed: pūrva apara citta kṣaṇayoḥ bodhau sāmānyena kāraṇa tvāt nirdiśya idānīm anvaya vyatireka mukhena dṛṣṭānta pūrvakam spaṣṭayan āha bīja ityādi nityasya krama yaugapadyābhyām arthakriyā virodhena śvattha ādi bīja ādeḥ ca uttara uttara kṣaṇa pariṇāmena tanu kārīṇi viṭapa ādīni samyak ātma bhāva lābhāt samāgacchanti

original: tacc ca bījaṃ stambhād utpattikāle niruddhaṃ tasya ca prathamato 'satve naivāśvatthādivṛkṣaḥ syāt / evam eva cittaṃ prathamam eva pradhānakāraṇatvān nidānaṃ bodhiviṣaye tata evottarottarapariṇāmayogena buddhatvaṃ sampadyate / tac ca buddhatvotpattikāle niruddhaṃ ta[80b]sya ca prathamato 'satve naiva bodhiḥ syāt // 3 //

original: dvitīyasyāpi cittakṣaṇasya kāraṇatvaṃ spaṣṭayann āha-bījam ityādi / dvitīyādikṣaṇabhāvi yavaśālikāder bījaṃ pratītyasamutpādadharmatābalāt pratītyaiva tat tad yavaśālikādiphalaṃ bhavati / na ca tad bījaṃ phalotpattikāle 'sti / upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalambhān na cāpi sarvathā kṣaṇaprabandho nāstīti śakyate niścetuṃ tadanukāriṇaḥ phalasyotpatteḥ /
analyzed: dvitīyasya api citta kṣaṇasya kāraṇa tvam spaṣṭayan āha bījam ityādi dvitīya ādi kṣaṇa bhāvi yava śālikā ādeḥ bījam pratītyasamutpāda dharma tā balāt pratītya eva tat tat yava śālikā ādi phalam bhavati na ca tat bījam phala utpatti kāle sti upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalambhāt na ca api sarvathā kṣaṇa prabandhaḥ na asti iti śakyate niścetum tad anukāriṇaḥ phalasya utpatteḥ

original: evam eva prathamacittakṣaṇabalotpannaṃ dvitīyādicittakṣaṇaṃ pratītya bhavati / bodhir iyaṃ jinānāṃ tattvato hetuphalabhāvasya boddhum aśakyatvāt bhāvasvabhāvarahitā yathā māyā jagatīha bhavet // 4 //

original: vistareṇaivaṃ nirdiśyopasaṃharann āha-daketyādi / yathodakabindubhiḥ kumbhaḥ paripūryate stokaṃ stokaṃ prathamato dakanipātenānupūrvyā sa paścimena tadvaccittena prathamenānuttarabodheḥ phenānupūrvyā sa dvitīyādicittakṣaṇena prayogamārgā[81a]disvabhāvatvāc chuklaguṇena prāptaparipūrṇasambhāratvāt pūrṇā bhavanti buddhaḥ // 5 //

original: prasaṃgagataṃ vistareṇa pratipāda prakṛtabhāvanāmārgastha[ḥ] bodhisattvāvaivartikalakṣaṇaṃ vaktum āha-śūnyetyādi / yathā nāvika[pu]ruṣo 'tiśikṣatatvāt kuśalo gacchati / nirupadravatayā pārāparaṃ mūlagrahaṇopāyatvena gamanāgamanakaru(ra)ṇān nobhayānte sthito vinipātasthānatvān na ca tiṣṭhati /
analyzed: prasaṃga gatam vistareṇa pratipāda prakṛta bhāvanā mārga sthaḥ bodhisattva avaivartika lakṣaṇam vaktum āha śūnya ityādi yathā nāvika puruṣaḥ kuśalaḥ gacchati nirupadrava tayā pāra aparam mūla grahaṇa upāya tvena gamana āgamana karuraṇāt na ubhaya ante sthitaḥ vinipāta sthāna tvāt na ca tiṣṭhati

original: arṇave 'sminn evam utpādādigāmbhīryayogād āsthāvinivṛttaye kāryakāraṇasvabhāvavirahād yathākramaṃ śūnyānimittāpraṇihitān sarvadharmān avagacchan bodhisattvo na ca nivrṭiṃ dayādhīnatvāt spṛśati sabhayatvān na ca nimittacārīti gāthārtho yojyaḥ // 6 //

original: tāś ca sarvasattvānāṃ hitārthaṃ yadānuttarbodhaye niryātanā[112b]t pariṇāmayanti / tadā daśabalānāṃ sambandhitvād gocare sarvāpattirahitatvād akhaṇḍaśīle sthitā bhavantīti gāthārtho yojyaḥ // 1 //

original: amum evārthaṃ vyatirekapūrvakaṃ spaṣṭayann āha-sa cītyādi / sa cet pratyekabuddhānām arhatāṃś ca bodhau gṛhītasaṃvarapariṇāmanāt spṛhāṃ janayati / tadā mahāyānapra[tipa]ttivirahād duḥśīlas tathā gṛhītasaṃvaraparityāgena cchidracārī bhaved viduṣāṃ tathāgatānām / atha bodhāv uttamaśivāyāṃ gṛhītaśīlaṃ pariṇāmayati /
analyzed: amum eva artham vyatireka pūrvakam spaṣṭayan āha sa ci ityādi sa ced pratyekabuddhānām arhatām ca bodhau gṛhīta saṃvara pariṇāmanāt spṛhām janayati tadā mahāyāna pratipatti virahāt duḥśīlaḥ tathā gṛhīta saṃvara parityāgena chidra cārī bhavet viduṣām tathāgatānām atha bodhau uttama śivāyām gṛhīta śīlam pariṇāmayati

original: evaṃ sthitā(taḥ) śīlapāramitāyāṃ gṛhītārthāparityāgāt kāmaguṇair api śīlāvirūddhair yuktaḥ // 2 //

original: kimartham evaṃ śīle prathamato 'vavāda iti ced āha-yo dharmetyādi / yasmād yo 'yaṃ svārthasampaddharmāṇām ubhayārthasampadbodheḥ parārthasampadguṇānāṃ ca pratilambhāt āgamo bodhisattvānāṃ sa śīlaprayojanenāpatsaṃrakṣaṇād guṇadharmasamanvitānāṃ bhavati /
analyzed: kimartham evam śīle prathamatas vavāda iti ced āha yaḥ dharma ityādi yasmāt yaḥ yam sva artha sampad dharmāṇām ubhaya artha sampad bodheḥ para artha sampad guṇānām ca pratilambhāt āgamaḥ bodhisattvānām sa śīla prayojanena āpad saṃrakṣaṇāt guṇa dharma samanvitānām bhavati

original: yā ca dharmabodhiguṇebhyaḥ parihāṇir hi[113a]takāriṇāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ duḥśīlatāyāḥ sambandhinīyaṃ prakāśitā nāyakena tasmāc chīla eva prathamato 'vavāda iti bhāvaḥ // 3 //
analyzed: yā ca dharma bodhi guṇebhyaḥ parihāṇiḥ hi ata kāriṇām bodhisattvānām duḥśīla tāyāḥ sambandhinī iyam prakāśitā nāyakena tasmāt śīlaḥ eva prathamatas vavāda iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiyatā śīle sthita ity āha-yadītyādi / yadi pañcakāmaguṇān api lokaprasiddhān bhuṅkte bodhisattvo 'ntasao(śo) ratnatrayaśaraṇaṃ ca yāvad ābodhimaṇḍagato bhaviṣyāmy ahaṃ buddho jagaddhitakārīti sarvajñatā cāsya manasi bhavet /
analyzed: kiyatā śīle sthitaḥ iti āha yadi ityādi yadi pañca kāmaguṇān api loka prasiddhān bhuṅkte bodhisattvaḥ ratnatraya śaraṇam ca yāvat ā bodhimaṇḍa gataḥ bhaviṣyāmi aham buddhaḥ jagat hita kārī iti sarvajña tā ca asya manasi bhavet

original: etāv atāpi bodhicittasaṃvaragrahaṇāc chīlapāramitāyāṃ vijñaḥ sthito jñeyo 'nyatra mahāyānasūtrānteṣv atiśayena bodhisaṃvaraśīlādeḥ prācuryeṇa nirdeśāt // 4 //
analyzed: etau bodhi citta saṃvara grahaṇāt śīla pāramitāyām vijñaḥ sthitaḥ jñeyaḥ nyatra mahāyāna sūtrānteṣu atiśayena bodhi saṃvara śīla ādeḥ prācuryeṇa nirdeśāt

original: saṃkṣepeṇa punaḥ sarvajñatāmanasikāravirahāt tu duḥśīla evetyāha-yadītyādi / yadi kalpakoṭiṃ prāṇātipātaviratyādibhir daśabhiḥ kuśalaiḥ karmapathaiś caran pratyekabuddhatve 'rhatve ca śīlapariṇāmanāt spṛhāṃ janayati tadā paurvavad dauśīlyayogāt khaṇḍaśīlas tathā [duḥ]śīlo 'pi bhavet /
analyzed: saṃkṣepeṇa punar sarvajña tā manasikāra virahāt tu duḥśīlaḥ evā iti āha yadi ityādi yadi kalpa koṭim prāṇa atipāta virati ādibhiḥ daśabhiḥ kuśalaiḥ karma pathaiḥ caran pratyekabuddha tve rha tve ca śīla pariṇāmanāt spṛhām janayati tadā paurva vat dauśīlya yogāt khaṇḍa śīlaḥ tathā duḥśīlaḥ api bhavet

original: yasmād bodhicittotpādena buddhatve nimantrya tato nivartate na sattvāṇāṃ visaṃyā(vā)da[113b]nāt pārājikato mūlāpatter gurutaro 'yaṃ cittotpādaḥ śrāvakādispṛhāsahagataḥ // 5 //

original: samyagamanujñāte 'pi śīle kathaṃ vartitavyam ity āha-rakṣetyādi / yathoktaśīlaṃ rakṣat(n)samādānagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ pari[ṇa]mathyāgrabodhau yadā na ca tenaiva śīlena parān nindanād avamanyate /
analyzed: samyak amanujñāte śīle katham vartitavyam iti āha rakṣā ityādi yathā ukta śīlam pariṇamathya agra bodhau yadā na ca tena eva śīlena parān nindanāt avamanyate

original: nāpi cātmānaṃ śīlavratābhimānād utkarṣati ataś cātmasaṃjñām upādeyatayā tathā heyatayā parasattvasaṃjñāṃ ca parivarjjya tadā yathoktaśīlapāramitāyāṃ sthita ity ucyate bodhisattvas tasmād evaṃ vartitavyam iti bhāvaḥ // 6 //
analyzed: na api ca ātmānam śīla vrata abhimānāt utkarṣati atas ca ātma saṃjñām upādeya tayā tathā heya tayā para sattva saṃjñām ca parivarjjya tadā yathā ukta śīla pāramitāyām sthitaḥ iti ucyate bodhisattvaḥ tasmāt evam vartitavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyathā tu doṣa evety āha-yadītyādi / yadi bodhisattvaś caran jinānāṃ yathoktaśīlatvāt mārge 'mī śīlavanto duḥśīlā iti heyopādeyatayā vyavasthāpayati / sattvānāṃs tadā nānātvasaṃjñāyāṃ pravṛttau vastūpalambhena sarvākāratayā rakṣitum aśakyatvāt pūrvavat parayo(mo) duḥśīlas tathā cchidraśīlo 'pyata eva na tv asau pariśuddhaśīlaḥ syāt /
analyzed: anyathā tu doṣaḥ evā iti āha yadi ityādi yadi bodhisattvaḥ caran jinānām yathā ukta śīla tvāt mārge śīlavantaḥ duḥśīlāḥ iti heya upādeya tayā vyavasthāpayati sattvānān tadā nānātva saṃjñāyām pravṛttau vastu upalambhena sarva ākāra tayā rakṣitum aśakya tvāt pūrvavat duḥśīlaḥ tathā chidra śīlaḥ api atas eva na tu asau pariśuddha śīlaḥ syāt

original: evaṃ ca vastūpalambhe na vidheya iti bhāvaḥ // 7 //
analyzed: evam ca vastu upalambhe na vidheyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ 7

original: anupalambhacā[114a]riṇaś cānāpattir ity āha-yasyo netyādi / yasya māyopamadharmatābalān nāsty ātmasaṃjñā na ca prasattvasaṃjñā tasya svaparavibhāgābhāvenānunayagratighavirahān nimittodgrahaṇavaimukhye sati niṣiddhavastvācaraṇābhāvān naivāsaṃvaro 'sti / evaṃ ca yasya na saṃvare śīlavrataparāmarṣadoṣatvān nāpy asaṃvare[ ']kuśalodayāvagraho 'sti /
analyzed: anupalambha cāriṇaḥ ca anāpattiḥ iti āha yasyaḥ na ityādi yasya māyā upama dharmatā balāt na asti ātma saṃjñā na ca tasya sva para vibhāga abhāvena anunaya gratigha virahāt nimitta udgrahaṇa vaimukhye sati niṣiddha vastu ācaraṇa abhāvāt na eva asaṃvaraḥ sti evam ca yasya na saṃvare śīla vrata parāmarṣa doṣa tvāt na api asaṃvare kuśala udaya avagrahaḥ sti

original: so 'yam aviparītapravṛttatvena śīlasaṃvarāt prakāśito nāyakena // 8 //
analyzed: saḥ yam a viparīta pravṛtta tvena śīla saṃvarāt prakāśitaḥ nāyakena

original: śīlānvitasyaivaṃ dāne pravṛttir ity āha-yo evetyādi / ya evānantaroktaśīlena saṃvṛtyā samanvāgataḥ paramārgena(rthena) ca niṣprapañco 'ta evāvagrahābhāvāt so 'napekṣako bhavati sarvasmin naiva priyāpriyavastūni /
analyzed: śīla anvitasya evam dāne pravṛttiḥ iti āha eva ityādi yaḥ eva anantara ukta śīlena saṃvṛtyā samanvāgataḥ para mārgena arthena ca eva avagraha abhāvāt saḥ bhavati sarvasmin na eva priya apriya vastūni

original: evaṃ cottamāṅgādīni tyajan līyamāne vastuni layābhāvād alīnacitto vidyamānārthatyāgāt sarvasvatyāgī satataṃ ca dānaphaleṣu nairapekṣyād alīno bhavet // 9 //
analyzed: evam ca uttamāṅga ādīni tyajan līyamāne vastuni laya abhāvāt alīna cittaḥ vidyamāna artha tyāgāt sarvasva tyāgī satatam ca dāna phaleṣu nairapekṣyāt alīnaḥ bhavet

original: bāhyavastuparityāgābhāvāt kathaṃ sarvatyāgī ced āha-jñātvetyādi / yatra hi nāma prajñāpūrvakāritayā dharmāṇāṃ pra[114b]kṛtiṃ saṃvṛtyā hetupratibaddhodayatvād vaśikāṃ paramārthena svabhāvavirahān nirātmikāṃ ca jñātvā yadātmano māṃsādikam tyajan na līnacittaḥ /
analyzed: bāhya vastu parityāga abhāvāt katham sarva tyāgī ced āha jñātvā ityādi yatra hi nāma prajñā pūrva kāri tayā dharmāṇām prakṛtim saṃvṛtyā hetu pratibaddha udaya tvāt vaśikām paramārthena svabhāva virahāt nirātmikām ca jñātvā yadā ātmanaḥ māṃsa ādikam tyajan na līna cittaḥ

original: kiṃ punar bāhyaṃ vastu tadā na tyajed evaṃ cāsambhavo 'nna bāhye vastuny asau mātsaryaṃ kuryād iti // 10 //
analyzed: kim punar bāhyam vastu tadā na tyajet evam ca asambhavaḥ bāhye vastuni asau mātsaryam kuryāt iti

original: nairātmyayogena kim arthaṃ dāne pravṛttir ity āha-ahetyādi / yady aham ity ātmani saṃjñāvastuni cātmīye mamatā bhaved anurāgo 'parityāgalakṣaṇas tadā naiva tyāgabuddhir bhaviṣyati upalambhatamasāvṛtatvena mūḍhānām / evaṃ ca te mātsaryāt pretabhavaneṣūpapadyante / athavā kathañcinmanuṣyeṣūpapadyante / tadā bhavanti dāridryaprāptāḥ /
analyzed: nairātmya yogena kim artham dāne pravṛttiḥ iti āha aha ityādi yadi aham iti ātmani saṃjñā vastuni ca ātmīye mamatā bhavet parityāga lakṣaṇaḥ tadā nā eva tyāga buddhiḥ bhaviṣyati upalambha tamasā āvṛta tvena mūḍhānām evam ca te mātsaryāt preta bhavaneṣu upapadyante athavā kathañcid manuṣyeṣu upapadyante tadā bhavanti dāridrya prāptāḥ

original: tataś ca yathoktanīty eva dāne pravṛttiḥ sthitam(tā) // 11 //

original: kimartham evaṃ dāne 'dhimuktir iti ced āha-tadetyādi / yademāṃ paśyati daridrān sattvāṃs tadā bodhisattvo dayāsampatyā yathokte dāne 'dhimuktaḥ san āgamādipramāṇopetatvena phalena saha sarvasvatyajanāt sadā yu(mu)ktatyāgī bhaved ataścaturo dvīpān saptaratnasamalaṅkṛtān tatra sa[115a]rvathāvagrahavirahāt khedatulyān trimaṇḍalapariśuddhiyogena datvā
analyzed: kimartham evam dāne dhimuktiḥ iti ced āha tadā ityādi yadā imām paśyati daridrān sattvān tadā bodhisattvaḥ dayā sampatyā yathā ukte dāne dhimuktaḥ san āgama ādi pramāṇa upeta tvena phalena saha sarvasva tyajanāt sadā bhavet atas caturaḥ dvīpān sapta ratna samalaṅkṛtān tatra sarvathā avagraha virahāt kheda tulyān tri maṇḍala pariśuddhi yogena

original: tadā saumanasyaprāpto bhaven na yathā dvīpān yathoktān labdhvā prāpyeti yāvat // 12 //
analyzed: tadā saumanasya prāptaḥ bhavet na yathā dvīpān yathā uktān labdhvā prāpya iti yāvat

original: yathoktaṃ ca dānam akṣayārtham anuttarabodhau pariṇāmayitavyam ity āha-dānam ityādi / anantaroktakrameṇa dānaṃ datvā vidvān paṇḍito bodhisattvo yāvantaḥ sattvās tribhaveṣu vidyante tān samanvāhṛtya sarvebhyas tebhyo bhavatv idaṃ dānaṃ dattam ity evam āśayena tadyānam agrabhodhau pariṇāmayati jagadartham eva /
analyzed: yathā uktam ca dānam akṣaya artham anuttara bodhau pariṇāmayitavyam iti āha dānam ityādi anantara ukta krameṇa dānam da tvā vidvān paṇḍitaḥ bodhisattvaḥ yāvantaḥ sattvāḥ tri bhaveṣu vidyante tān samanvāhṛtya sarvebhyaḥ tebhyaḥ bhavatu idam dānam dattam iti evam āśayena tat yānam agra bhodhau pariṇāmayati jagat artham eva

original: bodheḥ sattvānāṃ cākṣayatvād dānam akṣayaṃ syād iti bhāvaḥ // 13 //
analyzed: bodheḥ sattvānām ca akṣaya tvāt dānam akṣayam syāt iti bhāvaḥ 13

original: tatra tān abhi(tan nānabhi)niveśo(śa)phalam āvedayann āha-na cetyādi / deyadāyakapratigrāhakānupalambhād yo naiva vastv agrahaṃ karoti / datvā ca dānaṃ paramparānugrahabuddhyā tatphalābhilāṣān naiva kadācid vipākaṃ pratikāṅkṣati /
analyzed: tatra tān abhitas na an abhiniveśa uśa phalam āvedayan āha na ca ityādi deya dāyaka pratigrāhaka anupalambhāt yaḥ nā eva vastu agraham karoti da tvā ca dānam paramparā anugraha buddhyā tad phala abhilāṣāt nā eva kadācid vipākam pratikāṅkṣati

original: evaṃ sa phalena saha sarvasvajanān tyaktvā bhaved vidvān sarvasvatyāgī svalpaṃ ca tyaktvopāyakauśalabalāl labhate[ ']saṃkhyāpramāṇābhyāṃ paricche[115b]ttum aśakyatvād bahum aprameyaṃ ca vipākam iti śeṣaḥ // 14 //

original: mātsaryanigrahāya ca dānapāramitāvadanumodanāpūrvakaḥ pariṇāmo 'bhyasanīya ityāha-yāvantetyādi / yāvantaḥ sattvāḥ kāmarūpārūpyalakṣaṇatribhave sarvākāśadhātvantargatatvān nikhile sambhavanti /
analyzed: mātsarya nigrahāya ca dāna pāramitā vat anumodanā pūrvakaḥ pariṇāmaḥ bhyasanīyaḥ iti āha yāvanta ityādi yāvantaḥ sattvāḥ kāmarūpa ārūpya lakṣaṇa tri bhave sarva ākāśa dhātu antargata tvāt nikhile sambhavanti

original: te ca sarve dānaṃ dadanyatu(dadaty ananta)kalpān buddhebhyo lokavidbhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ pratyekabuddhebhyaś ca tathā cec chanti śrāvakaguṇā[n] tasyopalakṣaṇatavād buddhādiguṇāṃś ca / vastūpalambhayogena pravṛttatvāt parikalpasthāne sthitā iti bhāvaḥ /

original: yaś cānyaḥ samyagupāyakuśalo vidvān bodhisattvas teṣāṃ tatpuṇyakriyāvastvanummodya sattvārthaṃ pratyagrabodhau pariṇāmayed evaṃ cāsau mātsaryanigrahād abhibhavet sarvaṃ jagat // 15-16 //
